text_en: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the vinegrower.
text_cn: “我是真葡萄树，我父是园丁。

text_en: He removes every branch in me that bears no fruit. Every branch that bears fruit he prunes to make it bear more fruit.
text_cn: 凡在我身上不结实的枝条，他便剪掉；凡结实的，他就清理，使他结更多的果实；

text_en: You have already been cleansed by the word that I have spoken to you.
text_cn: 你们因我对你们所讲的话，已是清洁的了。

text_en: Abide in me as I abide in you. Just as the branch cannot bear fruit by itself unless it abides in the vine, neither can you unless you abide in me.
text_cn: 你们住在我内，我也住在你们内。正如枝条若不留在葡萄树上，凭自己不能结实；你们若不住在我内，也一无所能。

text_en: I am the vine, you are the branches. Those who abide in me and I in them bear much fruit, because apart from me you can do nothing.
text_cn: 我是葡萄树，你们是枝条；那住在我内，我也住在他内的，他就结许多的果实，因为离了我，你们什么也不能作。

text_en: Whoever does not abide in me is thrown away like a branch and withers; such branches are gathered, thrown into the fire, and burned.
text_cn: 谁若不住在我内，便仿佛枝条，丢在外面而枯干了，人便把它拾起来，投入火中焚烧。

text_en: If you abide in me, and my words abide in you, ask for whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
text_cn: 你们如果住在我内，而我的话也存在你们内，如此，你们愿意什么，求罢！必给你们成就。

text_en: My Father is glorified by this, that you bear much fruit and become my disciples.
text_cn: 我父受光荣，即在于你们多结果实，如此你们就成为我的门徒。

text_en: As the Father has loved me, so I have loved you; abide in my love.
text_cn: 正如父爱了我，同样我也爱了你们；你们应存在我的爱内。

text_en: If you keep my commandments, you will abide in my love, just as I have kept my Father’s commandments and abide in his love.
text_cn: 如果你们遵守我的命令，便存在我的爱内，正如我遵守了我父的命令而存在他的爱内一样。

text_en: I have said these things to you so that my joy may be in you, and that your joy may be complete.
text_cn: 我对你们讲论了这些事，为使我的喜乐存在你们内，使你们的喜乐圆满无缺。”

text_en: “This is my commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.
text_cn: “这是我的命令：你们该彼此相爱，如同我爱了你们一样。

text_en: No one has greater love than this, to lay down one’s life for one’s friends.
text_cn: 人若为自己的朋友舍掉性命，再没有比这更大的爱情了。

text_en: You are my friends if you do what I command you.
text_cn: 你们如果实行我所命令你们的，你们就是我的朋友。

text_en: I do not call you servants any longer, because the servant does not know what the master is doing; but I have called you friends, because I have made known to you everything that I have heard from my Father.
text_cn: 我不再称你们为仆人，因为仆人不知道他主人所做的事。我称你们为朋友，因为凡由我父听来的一切，我都显示给你们了。

text_en: You did not choose me but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit, fruit that will last, so that the Father will give you whatever you ask him in my name.
text_cn: 不是你们拣选了我，而是我拣选了你们，并派你们去结果实，去结常存的果实；如此，你们因我的名无论向父求什么，他必赐给你们。

text_en: I am giving you these commands so that you may love one another.
text_cn: 这就是我命令你们的：你们应该彼此相爱。”

text_en: “If the world hates you, be aware that it hated me before it hated you.
text_cn: “世界若恨你们，你们该知道，在你们以前，它已恨了我。

text_en: If you belonged to the world, the world would love you as its own. Because you do not belong to the world, but I have chosen you out of the world—therefore the world hates you.
text_cn: 若是你们属于世界，世界必喜爱你们，有如属于自己的人；但因你们不属于世界，而是我从世界中拣选了你们，为此，世界才恨你们。

text_en: Remember the word that I said to you, ‘Servants are not greater than their master. ’ If they persecuted me, they will persecute you; if they kept my word, they will keep yours also.
text_cn: 你们要记得我对你们所说过的话：没有仆人大过主人的；如果人们迫害了我，也要迫害你们；如果他们遵守了我的话，也要遵守你们的。

text_en: But they will do all these things to you on account of my name, because they do not know him who sent me.
text_cn: 但是，他们为了我名字的缘故，要向你们作这一切，因为他们不认识那派遣我来的。

text_en: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
text_cn: 假使我没有来，没有教训他们，他们就没有罪；但现在他们对自己的罪，是无可推诿的。

text_en: Whoever hates me hates my Father also.
text_cn: 恨我的，也恨我的父。

text_en: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did, they would not have sin. But now they have seen and hated both me and my Father.
text_cn: 假使我在他们中，没有做过其他任何人从未做过的事业，他们便没有罪；然而，现在他们看见了，却仍恨了我和我父。

text_en: It was to fulfill the word that is written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause. ’
text_cn: 但这是为应验他们法律上所记载的话：‘他们无故地恼恨了我。’

text_en: “When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth who comes from the Father, he will testify on my behalf.
text_cn: 当护慰者，就是我从父那里给你们派遣的，那发于父的真理之神来到时，他必要为我作证；

text_en: You also are to testify because you have been with me from the beginning.
text_cn: 并且你们也要作证，因为你们从开始就和我在一起。”
